questions.prompt: What is the difference between `Console.Write("string")` and `Console.WriteLine("string")`?
options: `Write` prints to a file and `WriteLine` prints to the screen
`WriteLine` prints the value and then moves the cursor to the next line; `Write` does not
`WriteLine` can only print strings; `Write` can print any variable
`Write` clears the screen before printing; `WriteLine` does not
questions.explanation: `WriteLine` is the same as `Write` but adds the current line terminator, so the cursor moves to the next line after printing.

questions.prompt: Which data type should hold the return value of `Console.Read()`?
options: `string`, because it returns the whole line typed
`char`, because it returns the character itself
`int`, because it returns the ASCII value of a single character
questions.explanation: `Read()` reads a single character from the keyboard and returns its ASCII value, so the data type should be `int`.

questions.prompt: Which method returns a `ConsoleKeyInfo` describing the key that was entered?
questions.explanation: `ReadKey()` reads a single character and returns its key information as a `ConsoleKeyInfo`. `ReadLine()` returns a `string` and `Read()` returns an `int`.

questions.prompt: Which method sets the console's foreground and background colors back to their defaults?
questions.explanation: `ResetColor()` sets the foreground and background console colors to their defaults. `Clear()` clears the screen but does not reset the colors.
